---

## Overview

Sorabbyngo Labs is building an AI-native operating system designed for offline and low-connectivity environments.

---

## Core Systems

- Sorabbyngo OS — AI-native operating system  
- Novela — AI health platform  
- Byngonet — mesh networking (research)  
- Byngox — reasoning engine (in development)  
- Chameha — voice interface (concept)  
- CML — safety layer (design phase)  

---

## Status

- Architecture defined  
- Build environment in progress  
- Kernel work experimental  

---

## Note

This is an early-stage engineering project.
